test_scope: tests/semantic_state (432 tests). The full 7,441-test suite was also run against all 26 survivors of the 82.3% census: every one produced an IDENTICAL 5-test failure set, which is the copy-artifact baseline (the rsync'd tree omits .venv and five tests shell out to .venv/bin/hml). The wider suite therefore contributes ZERO additional kills, and any 'KILLED_BY_FULL_SUITE' label without that baseline subtraction is an artifact.
method: Every survivor was run through a 219-probe differential battery (70 corpus fixtures in BOTH trust modes, plus hand-built adversarial payloads, renderer round trips, malformed view text, neutral key-namespace probes and direct domain-lattice manipulation). A survivor is classified REDUNDANT_DEFENCE only where no probe distinguishes the mutated build from the pristine one AND the refusing path is identified in source. This is evidence of non-observability through the public contract, not a proof of semantic equivalence.

survivors.invariant: D-048: the absent-input-domain guard is removed (would crash inhabits on None)

survivors.justification: An absent input domain is collected by `_collect_unknowns` as 'domain is not declared', which short-circuits the whole transition to UNRESOLVED before `_check_type_domain` runs. The guard cannot be reached with a payload that would crash it.

survivors.invariant: the lattice is no longer checked acyclic at import
survivors.justification: Mutually redundant with M123's runtime guard in `inhabits()`. Removing the import-time assertion alone cannot cause non-termination because the loop guard still bounds traversal; M123 is now killed by an explicitly bounded test, so the pair cannot both be removed undetected.

survivors.invariant: an unterminated quoted name is accepted

survivors.new:

survivors.justification: An unterminated quote in an identifier list is refused downstream by `_read_ident`'s bare-name check (the M140 guard), which is itself pinned by test_an_unquotable_bare_name_is_refused_on_readback.
